PhD Research Studentships
We offer studentships in a range of categories. These are usually fully-funded, with a stipend and tuition fee covered. We welcome all applications from suitably qualified students (minimum equivalent of an upper second class honours degree or international equivalent).
Please apply early in order to check your eligibility and to improve your chances of selection.
Funded Studentships
Self-Funded Studentships
We offer a range of PhD projects for students who have already secured full funding (tuition and fees) elsewhere.
Other sources of funding
The Queen Mary website offers a full list of scholarships and funding, have a look at which might apply to you.
